response.rationale: The corrected cue accurately covers both gender-neutral forms. Indonesian tunangan and Malaysian tunang mean a fiancé or fiancée, so the original masculine-only sense was appropriately broadened. The forms are close equivalents, with no material false-friend contrast; “similar” is appropriate.
